item.title: pbump.com: The nine-year old wanted to play Lions-Bears on Madden, went up 27-0 as the Lion
item.description: The nine-year old wanted to play Lions-Bears on Madden, went up 27-0 as the Lions at the half and then lost 42-41. Probably shouldn’t have listened when I told him that a prevent was a good way to defend against my last-second 2-point conversion.
